# GeoImpact Evidence Copilot V0.2: human-review checklist

**Review status: UNREVIEWED.** This file is generated by `geoimpact-copilot/semantic/build-review-checklist.mjs` from `approved-skeletons.json`. Every box is unchecked and every decision is blank. No person has confirmed any sentence below, and no automated process in this repository may fill the fields in. The gate enforces the vocabulary whether or not it has been reviewed; review decides whether the vocabulary should be trusted, not whether it is enforced.

## How to review

For each entry, read the sentence as a user would read it next to its report, then answer: (1) Is it true for **every** report for which its conditions hold? (2) Does it assert, or imply, anything about geography, time, cause, legal status or scientific validity that the GeoImpact-CI report cannot support? (3) If it is a disclaimer, is the negation accurate against the cited contract text shown? (4) Is any `{{slot}}` rendered with the right label and unit? Record *Approve*, *Reject* or *Change*, your name and the date. Only after every entry is decided may `review.status` in `approved-skeletons.json` be changed, by the reviewer, together with `reviewed_by` and `reviewed_on`.

Automated flags are keyword hints for where to look. An absent flag does not mean a sentence is safe, and a present flag does not mean it is wrong.

- `affirmative`: the sentence states something. Check it against the report.
- `disclaimer`: the sentence is negated ("no", "not", "cannot"). Check the negation against the cited contract text.
- `geographic`, `temporal`, `causal`, `legal`, `scientific`: the constant text contains a word from that area. **Any affirmative sentence flagged here is an unsupported interpretation unless the report field supporting it is named.**

## Slot fields (label and unit rendered by the gate)

- `analysis.crs`: analysis CRS (#/analysis/crs)
- `analysis.dependency_dataset`: dependency dataset (#/analysis/dependencies/\d+/dataset)
- `analysis.primary_dataset`: primary dataset (#/analysis/primary_dataset)
- `policy.observed_value`: observed … relationship regressions (#/policy/observed_value)
- `policy.threshold`: threshold of … relationship regressions (#/policy/threshold)
- `primary_change.added_feature_ids`: Added: (#/primary_change/added_feature_ids)
- `primary_change.changed_feature_ids`: Changed feature IDs: (#/primary_change/changed_feature_ids)
- `primary_change.changed_footprint_area_m2`: Changed footprint area: … m² (#/primary_change/changed_footprint_area_m2)
- `primary_change.max_boundary_displacement_m`: Maximum boundary displacement: … m (#/primary_change/max_boundary_displacement_m)
- `primary_change.modified_feature_ids`: Modified: (#/primary_change/modified_feature_ids)
- `primary_change.removed_feature_ids`: Removed: (#/primary_change/removed_feature_ids)
- `provenance.engine.geoimpact_ci`: GeoImpact-CI (#/provenance/engine/geoimpact_ci)
- `provenance.engine.geos`: GEOS (#/provenance/engine/geos)
- `provenance.engine.proj`: PROJ (#/provenance/engine/proj)
- `provenance.engine.pyproj`: PyProj (#/provenance/engine/pyproj)
- `provenance.engine.shapely`: Shapely (#/provenance/engine/shapely)
- `provenance.hash_algorithm`: hash algorithm (#/provenance/hash_algorithm)
- `relationship.after`: after (#/relationship_regressions/\d+/after)
- `relationship.before`: before (#/relationship_regressions/\d+/before)
- `relationship.change_type`: change type (#/relationship_regressions/\d+/change_type)
- `relationship.dependent_dataset`: Dependent dataset (#/relationship_regressions/\d+/dependent_dataset)
- `relationship.dependent_id`: dependent ID (#/relationship_regressions/\d+/dependent_id)
- `relationship.evidence_id`: Evidence ID (#/relationship_regressions/\d+/evidence_id)
- `relationship.primary_feature_ids`: primary feature IDs (#/relationship_regressions/\d+/primary_feature_ids)
- `relationship_regressions.count`: lists … changed dependent relationship records (#/relationship_regressions)
- `report_version`: report version (#/report_version)
